content: Rate-limit data sources: stdin rate_limits.five_hour/seven_day is native and preferred (Claude Code >=2.1.x, Pro/Max). Model-specific weekly quota (e.g. Opus/Fable weekly) is NOT in the stdin payload; community projects (ohugonnot/claude-code-statusline) fall back to undocumented https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, cached ~300s; endpoint could change without notice; aggressive refresh causes rate limiting; graceful degradation recommended. On macOS credentials may live in Keychain rather than .credentials.json (LOW confidence).
